name: Solomon's Special Day
source:
With Solomon's birthday nearing, the tension is high in Purgatory Hall as they scrambled about their final party preparations. However, Luke and Simeon find themselves in a bind when a mysterious picture book arrives at their doorstep instead of their birthday present! 

Pressed for time, the angels find themselves in deeper troubles when the said book whisks them away in someone's dream...and the only way to get out is...? 

[From [url=https://solomonday.itch.io/solomons-special-day]Itch.io[/url]]
